Summarise movement phases

Source: R/phase.summary.R
phase.summary.Rd

Builds a table with one row per movement phase of each individual, as classified by class.mov: its start, end, duration, number of locations, distance travelled, net displacement and, for movements, the ARPs where they start and end.

Usage

phase.summary(
  data,
  id.col = "ID",
  time.col = "time",
  phase.col = "phase",
  coord.names = c("x", "y")
)

Arguments

data

An object of class disperseR returned by class.mov, or a data.frame with the same columns.

id.col

Character. Name of the column containing individual identifiers. Default is "ID".

time.col

Character. Name of the column containing timestamps (POSIXct). Default is "time".

phase.col

Character. Name of the column containing the movement phases. Default is "phase".

coord.names

Character vector of length 2 with the names of the X and Y coordinate columns (projected, in metres). Default is c("x", "y").

Value

A data.frame with columns ID (named as id.col), n_phase, phase, arp, from, to, start, end, duration_days, n_locations, distance_km and displacement_km.

Details

Consecutive locations with the same phase form one row. Consecutive ARP locations belonging to different linked clusters (linked_clusters) form separate rows. distance_km is the sum of the distances between consecutive locations of the phase, and displacement_km the straight-line distance between its first and last location. from and to give the ARP (linked_clusters) before and after each phase.

Examples

eps <- get.epsilon(sim_states)
#> Computing a global threshold using all data combined.
arp <- get.arp(sim_states, epsilon = eps, delta.days = 2, pct.state1 = 0.2)
mov <- class.mov(link.arp(arp, thres = 24 * 3600))
ph <- phase.summary(mov)
head(ph)
#>    ID n_phase  phase   arp  from    to               start                 end
#> 1 F02       1 Type 0  <NA>  <NA> arp_1 2024-03-01 11:56:18 2024-03-03 17:56:18
#> 2 F02       2    ARP arp_1  <NA>  <NA> 2024-03-03 18:56:18 2024-03-11 19:56:18
#> 3 F02       3 Type 2  <NA> arp_1 arp_2 2024-03-11 20:56:18 2024-03-13 17:56:18
#> 4 F02       4    ARP arp_2  <NA>  <NA> 2024-03-13 18:56:18 2024-03-16 17:56:18
#> 5 F02       5 Type 2  <NA> arp_2 arp_3 2024-03-16 18:56:18 2024-03-17 17:56:18
#> 6 F02       6    ARP arp_3  <NA>  <NA> 2024-03-17 18:56:18 2024-03-26 19:56:18
#>   duration_days n_locations distance_km displacement_km
#> 1     2.2500000          55   15.736831      14.1350608
#> 2     8.0416667         194   17.682587       0.9518428
#> 3     1.8750000          46   16.005406      12.5102060
#> 4     2.9583333          72    6.535382       0.2658206
#> 5     0.9583333          24   10.749695       9.4423885
#> 6     9.0416667         218   20.905722       0.6053980

# Total distance travelled outside ARPs per individual
tapply(ph$distance_km[ph$phase != "ARP"], ph$ID[ph$phase != "ARP"], sum)
#>      F02      F04      F05      M01      M03 
#> 63.20082 57.97788 84.48324 91.58864 61.15221
